# Transformational Bioinformatics

> CSIRO's Transformational Bioinformatics delivers cutting-edge genomics, machine learning, and gene therapy solutions for research and industry.

This is CSIRO's bioinformatics division based in Australia, offering software tools, scientific research, and consulting services in genomics, therapeutics, and biosecurity. The team is led by Prof. Denis Bauer and focuses on cloud-native, machine learning-driven approaches to biological data analysis.

## Key Topics

- machine learning
- genomics
- gene therapy
- AAV capsids
- COVID-19 variants
- CapBuild
- VariantSpark
- consent management
- cloud-native architecture
- SARS-CoV-2
- biosecurity
- advanced therapeutics
- bioinformatics science
- vaccine development
- international collaboration

## Research & Innovation

- [Machine Learning provides early warning for emerging COVID-19 variants](https://bioinformatics.csiro.au/blog/machine_learning_provides_early_warning_for_covid-19_variants): Blog article on VariantSpark ML tool for COVID-19 variant detection
- [CapBuild: democratizing AAV capsid engineering through the web](https://bioinformatics.csiro.au/blog/capbuild-democratizing-aav-capsid-engineering-through-the-web): Blog article on CapBuild web platform for AAV capsid design and gene therapy
